basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm Alex, a university student at Rowan University majoring in Business Administration. I'm fairly new to Reddit but have quickly become absorbed in the world of Royale High Trading. I love attending music festivals like Shaky Knees and exploring new trading strategies. I'm from New Jersey and usually active in the evenings after classes or on weekends. Not a huge fan of on-sale items or anything too mainstream. Currently single and enjoying campus life!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in business studies, I've developed a knack for understanding market trends and trading strategies, which I apply to virtual economies like Royale High. My interest in trading was piqued through gaming communities and self-teaching.
